take: Anaheim announced it reassigned centers Roger McQueen and Cruz Lucius to San Diego (AHL), recalled defensemen Noah Warren, Ian Mitchell and Tristan Luneau, placed Drew Helleson on injured reserve, and moved Troy Terry to long-term injured reserve. Helleson's minutes should go to Tyson Hinds and Pavel Mintyukov, who are both playing more in the one game since he went out. Luneau, a top-pair defenseman at 19:28 a night, comes back with Anaheim holding 54.6% of the expected goals (a measure of chance quality) at five-on-five while he plays.
